common.improvement_note: Feel free to improve the data and make it more professional and better-looking to improve the chances of hiring, but do not add any information that is not provided.
common.omit_note: If any fields are not provided (i.e., `None`), omit those sections.

header.title: Create a professional and polished header for the resume
requirements: Contact Information: Include full name, city and country, phone number, email address, LinkedIn profile, and GitHub profile
Formatting: Ensure the contact details are presented clearly and are easy to read

education.title: Articulate the educational background for a resume
requirements: Institution Name and Location: Specify the university or educational institution's name and location
Degree and Field of Study: Clearly indicate the degree earned and the field of study
Grade: Include your Grade if it is strong and relevant

experience.title: Detail the work experience for a resume
requirements: Company Name and Location: Provide the name of the company and its location
Job Title: Clearly state your job title
Dates of Employment: Include the start and end dates of your employment
Responsibilities and Achievements: Describe your key responsibilities and notable achievements, emphasizing measurable results and specific contributions.

projects.title: Highlight notable side projects
requirements: Project Name and Link: Provide the name of the project and include a link to the GitHub repository or project page
Project Details: Describe any notable recognition or achievements related to the project
Technical Contributions: Highlight your specific contributions and the technologies used in the project

achievements.title: List significant achievements
requirements: Award or Recognition: Clearly state the name of the award, recognition, scholarship, or honor
Description: Provide a brief description of the achievement and its relevance

certifications.title: List significant certifications
requirements: Certification Name: Clearly state the name of the certification
Description: Provide a brief description of the certification and its relevance

skills.title: List additional skills relevant to the job
requirements: Skill Category: Clearly state the category or type of skill
Specific Skills: List the specific skills or technologies within each category
Proficiency and Experience: Briefly describe your experience and proficiency level

common.format_note: Write a brief and impactful cover letter no longer than three paragraphs in a professional, yet conversational tone.
common.structure_note: The letter should be formatted into paragraphs and should not include a greeting or signature.

main.title: Create a professional cover letter based on the provided job description and resume
requirements: Analysis: Identify key qualifications and requirements from the job description
Introduction: Introduce the candidate succinctly, aligning career objectives with the role
Body: Highlight relevant skills and experiences that match job demands, using specific examples
Company Focus: Reference notable aspects of the company that resonate with professional goals
Closing: Make a strong statement about fit for the position and express desire to discuss further
rules: Do not include any introductions or explanations

analysis.title: Analyze job requirements and match with candidate profile
sections: Technical Skills: List all specific technical skills required
Soft Skills: Identify necessary soft skills
Professional Experience: Describe relevant work experiences
Role Evolution: Analyze future trends and requirements
rules: Order by relevance to job requirements
Do not add or infer information not provided
